subject.title: fix(slack): respect group DM sender allowlists [AI]

question: Should Slack MPDM ingress fail closed to explicit stable Slack user IDs in `channels.slack.allowFrom`, excluding wildcard, pairing-store, mutable-name, and channel-member fallback authorization for MPDM senders?
rationale: The PR tightens a Slack authorization boundary but intentionally narrows existing MPDM behavior and can require operator config changes, so maintainer intent is needed after the W-ID bug and proof gap are addressed.

options.title: Accept Explicit-ID MPDM Gate After Fix And Proof
options.body: Broaden the explicit-ID filter to the full stable Slack ID contract, require redacted live MPDM allow/deny proof, then accept the fallback removal as intended behavior.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility By Default
options.body: Keep wildcard or fallback MPDM behavior for existing setups and require a separate strict mode or migration plan before fail-closing MPDMs.

options.title: Pause For Broader Slack Auth Design
options.body: Hold this PR until MPDM docs, operator migration, and adjacent Slack interaction behavior can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit-ID MPDM Gate After Fix And Proof
recommendation.body: Broaden the explicit-ID filter to the full stable Slack ID contract, require redacted live MPDM allow/deny proof, then accept the fallback removal as intended behavior.
